basics.name: Aldo A. Arellano, PhD
basics.label: Postdoctoral Fellow
basics.summary: Microbial ecologist studying host–microbe interactions, aquatic microbiomes, and cross-domain ecosystem dynamics. Current work integrates bacterial and eukaryotic community ecology, multi-omics, and field-based freshwater research in the Laurentian Great Lakes.

work.name: University of Michigan
work.position: Postdoctoral Fellow, Cooperative Institute for Great Lakes Research (CIGLR) and Institute for Global Change Biology (IGCB)
work.summary: Postdoctoral research on microbial and eukaryotic dynamics in Great Lakes ecosystems.
highlights: Advisors: Dr. Gregory Dick and Dr. Meghan Duffy
Research integrates microbial ecology, freshwater food webs, genomics, and environmental change biology.

work.name: University of Wisconsin-Madison
work.summary: Postdoctoral research in the Coon Laboratory on ecological perspectives of microbiota function in mosquitoes.
highlights: Advisor: Dr. Kerri Coon
Studied environmentally acquired microbiota in insect-associated aquatic microecosystems.

work.name: University of Wisconsin-Madison
work.position: PhD Trainee, Microbiology Doctoral Training Program
work.summary: Dissertation research on host-microbe feedbacks in a tripartite symbiosis.
highlights: Advisor: Dr. Kerri Coon
Studied mosquito-mediated structuring of bacterial communities in pitcher plant aquatic microecosystems.
Integrated community ecology, microbiome sequencing, experimental microcosms, and microbial functional analyses.

work.name: DermBiont Inc.
work.summary: Industry internship in molecular diagnostics research.
highlights: Performed molecular and microbiological research in an applied biotechnology setting.

work.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
work.position: Research Technician, Chisholm Laboratory, Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering
work.summary: Research on Prochlorococcus ecology, evolution, and microbial interactions.
highlights: Contributed to integrative studies of Prochlorococcus, Synechococcus, microbial vesicles, and ocean microbial ecology.
Supported projects involving microbial culturing, genomics, and marine microbial physiology.

work.name: University of Wisconsin-Madison
work.position: REU Fellow, Ives Laboratory and Lake Mývatn Research Station
work.summary: Research on spatiotemporal dynamics of diverse taxa in Lake Mývatn, Iceland.
highlights: Conducted limnological and ecological fieldwork across aquatic and terrestrial systems.
Worked with arthropod, dipteran, phytoplankton, and zooplankton sampling.

work.name: Dartmouth College
work.summary: Undergraduate research in ecology, thermal acclimation, and cyanobacterial bloom dynamics.
highlights: Studied thermal acclimation effects on population dynamics in variable thermal environments.
Contributed to long-term monitoring of bloom-forming cyanobacteria in Lake Sunapee, New Hampshire.
Conducted honors thesis research on cyanobacterial density and colony morphology.

projects.name: Great Lakes microbial and eukaryotic food web dynamics
projects.summary: Postdoctoral research integrating bacterial and eukaryotic community data to understand cross-domain ecological dynamics under nutrient and environmental stress regimes in the Laurentian Great Lakes.
highlights: Connects microbial ecology with zooplankton and broader freshwater food web processes.
Integrates sequencing, field sampling, and ecosystem-scale questions.

projects.name: Host-microbe feedbacks in pitcher plant mosquito microecosystems
projects.summary: Doctoral research investigating how mosquito hosts shape the composition, diversity, and function of environmentally acquired bacterial communities in carnivorous pitcher plant aquatic microecosystems.
highlights: Examined host-mediated niche construction and microbiota assembly.
Linked microbial community structure to host development and ecosystem function.
